summary: Produced LLD for BUG-88 — all interactive elements non-functional. Root cause: systemic event handler wiring gaps across 5 components. Fixes: mount 3 missing hooks in App.tsx, wire onClick handlers in Toolbar/BrickPalette, wire pointer events in Viewport, add onBrickClick to BrickInstances, fix OrbitControls event capture. No engine/store/service changes needed. 14 regression tests defined.

human_review_required.reason: Changing this may affect camera UX — verify right-click orbit still works as expected after fix
Verify this doesn't break any other event listeners on parent elements

recommended_actions: Read docs/features/BUG-88/LOW_LEVEL_DESIGN.md in full before writing any code
Follow the Implementation Order in Section 11 (CSS → BrickPalette → Toolbar → App → BrickInstances → Viewport)
Start with index.css audit — if pointer-events:none is found, fix it first
Use useCallback for all event handlers returned from hooks (Section 9.1)
Verify OrbitControls fix with manual testing: right-click should orbit, left-click should place bricks
Run full test suite after each step to catch regressions early
